name: California halibut
notes: Boat limits apply. Fillets allowed only S of Pt Arena: each fillet min 16.75 in with ENTIRE skin intact, not cut in half (lengthwise midline cut OK if joined 2 in at one end). Measure TL mouth closed to end of longest tail lobe.

name: Pacific sanddab
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Federal groundfish ('other flatfish'). No take in the 8 offshore Groundfish Exclusion Areas (§27.50). Does not count toward 20-fish general limit. Other sanddab species (speckled, longfin) fall under general 10/20 limit.

name: Soles (rock/sand/butter)
bag: 10 per species, part of 20 finfish total
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Rock, sand, butter, curlfin, rex and flathead sole = federal 'other flatfish' (§1.91(a)(10)). No take in Groundfish Exclusion Areas (§27.50). Fillets need 1 in square skin patch.

name: Petrale sole / starry flounder
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Federal groundfish regulated as a pair under §28.47. No take in Groundfish Exclusion Areas (§27.50). Not counted toward 20-fish general limit (§27.60(b)).

name: Other flatfish (turbots, C-O)
bag: 10 per species, part of 20 finfish total
notes: Diamond turbot, hornyhead turbot, C-O sole, fantail sole, speckled sanddab etc. are NOT federal groundfish; general limit §27.60(a) applies. ID caution: juvenile California halibut have a 22 in size limit.

name: Surfperch (all species)
bag: 20 combined (excl. shiner), max 10 of any one species
notes: Family Embiotocidae: barred, walleye, rubberlip, black, pile, white etc. Counts toward 20-finfish general limit. SF/San Pablo Bay 5-fish limit and Apr-Jul closure do not apply in SoCal. Fillets need 1 in square skin patch.

name: Redtail surfperch
notes: Only surfperch with a size limit; therefore may not be filleted on a boat or brought ashore as fillets (§27.65(c)). Mainly a central/northern species, uncommon in SoCal.

name: Shiner perch
notes: Special limit of 20 shiner perch does not count toward the 20 surfperch aggregate or the 20-finfish general limit. Also legal by dip net / baited hoop net (§28.80). Bait-size fish; rarely speared.

name: California corbina
notes: No species-specific section; general limit §27.60(a). Fillets need 1 in square skin patch. Often found in surf zone inside MPAs (check MPA boundaries).

name: Spotfin croaker
notes: Not named in regs; general limit §27.60(a) applies. Fillets need 1 in square skin patch. Check OEHHA consumption advisories for LA/Orange County coast.

name: Yellowfin croaker
notes: Not named in regs; general limit §27.60(a) applies. Fillets need 1 in square skin patch.

name: White croaker (tomcod)
notes: General limit §27.60(a). HEALTH: OEHHA advises against eating white croaker from the Palos Verdes/Santa Monica Bay area (PCB/DDT); §104 commercial closure off Pt Vicente-Pt Fermin is commercial only. See oehha.ca.gov/fish.

name: Salmon (Chinook)
season: Sep 1 - Sep 30, 2026 (Pigeon Pt to Mexico) or until 20,000 fall guideline
spear: PROHIBITED by spear (hook and line only)
notes: §28.90 excludes salmon from spearfishing; angling only (§27.80(a)). No coho retention. Possession: max 2 daily limits on land, 1 on a vessel. NMFS may close early; call (800) 662-9825. Uncommon south of Pt Conception.

name: Striped bass
size: None south of Pt Conception (18 in TL north)
notes: Rare in SoCal ocean waters. No sinker over 4 lb, no power gurdy/winch; snagging illegal. OEHHA mercury advisory for striped bass (fish that migrate).
